title: Bismuth Nanowires Prepared by Pulsed Laser Deposition and Possible Nucleation and Growth Mechanism
content: Bismuth (Bi) is a group V semi-metal with a rhombohedral crystal structure and it has garnered significant attention over several decades due to its unique physical properties, including low charge carrier density, large mean free path, and high electron mobility [1, 2]. Bismuth nanowires (NWs) are currently under intensive investigation to explore the distinctive quantum phenomena resulting from Bi’s anomalous characteristics [3, 4].
